headline: Nigerian Naira Weakens to 1,346 per Dollar, Erasing October Gains
summary: The Nigerian naira weakened from N1,329.50 per dollar at the end of September to N1,346 on October 30, reversing about 42% of its recent three-month gains.
why: Nigeria's foreign exchange rate directly affects domestic inflation, import dependency, and external debt obligations in Africa's largest economy.
